Alex: Kicking off preflight for tonight's deploy window (00:00-02:00 UTC). Components: runtime v2.4.1 (KV eviction fix), api v1.9.0 (header-swap), router 3.2. Console change is a UI toggle only. Plan: canary -> 25% -> 100%. Pins needed for router + runtime. Anyone object or have open blockers?
Jamal: Quick question — is router schema fully compatible with the API header-swap? Last time console relied on the old header shape.
Maria: Confirmed: router 3.2 supports the new header shape fallback. API header-swap will be behind a header flag. Console toggle defaults OFF so no immediate client-visible change. We should pin API v1.9.0 in EU to avoid mixed-version routing there.
Rachael: Heads-up: runtime KV eviction behavior changed slightly. Recommend a 15min warmup with low-traffic ramp (blue/green warm pool) before we hit 25%. Also add a metric check for `runtime.kv.evictions` during canary.
SRE_Oncall: We'll watch p95, p99, and `runtime.kv.evictions`. Suggest alert rule: `runtime.kv.evictions > 50/min for 5m` -> pause rollout.
Alex: Noted. Action items: add alert, warmup window, EU pin for API. Deploybot — can you confirm timing and fallback config?
deploybot: Affirmative. Planned timeline: canary start 00:15 UTC (smoke at 23:30), step to 25% at 00:30, 50% at 00:45, 100% at 01:15. Pins: router=3.2, runtime=2.4.1. API pinned to 1.9.0 in EU only. Rollback triggers: p95 latency increase >40% sustained 3m OR error-rate >1% sustained 3m. Automatic fallback to compatible variant enabled.
Jamal: Can we add an automated fallback route to API v1.8.8 if header issues are detected? That preserves consumers that haven't toggled.
deploybot: Automatic fallback configured. Conditions: error-rate >1% for 5m OR p95 >60% for 3m -> switch traffic to `api v1.8.8` in affected regions. Manual rollback requires >2 approvals.
Maria: I'll update the release notes with the header flag migration steps and ping CS to prepare a short KB. Also attaching a one-line upgrade note to the console toggle docs.
Alex: Final checklist: release notes ✅, pins set ✅, alerts ✅, warmup plan ✅, rollback automation ✅. Any last-call objections? 5m.
Rachael: Ack, I'll be oncall for runtime during the window and will monitor `kv.evictions` and memory churn.
SRE_Oncall: I'm on pager for infra spikes and will monitor router/backplane metrics. Ops channel will be open during the window.
Alex: Launching preflight smoke at 23:30 UTC. Will post results there. :rocket:
